en: The image shows an old, hand-colored postcard depicting a prominent white Orthodox church with green domes. The church is at the end of a street with people walking along the sidewalk and older European-style buildings on either side. Trees obscure part of the church. The upper part of the image has printed German text 'Reval. Die russische Nicolai-Kirche.' and handwritten text in Swedish in blue ink across the sky.
